sections.title: Sectio 127 - Collection of Tax from Commissions on Government Stamps, Court Fees, Cartridge Paper An
sections.content_text: Sectio 127 - Collection of Tax from Commissions on Government Stamps, Court Fees, Cartridge Paper Any person authorized for the payment of commission, batta or fees whatever name called against the sale of Government stamp, court fee, cartridge paper or anything else or a similar nature shall deduct tax at the rate of 10% (ten percent) at time of payment of the amount so paid.
